mapper.insert:
with incoming as (select #{launchPayload}::jsonb as payload) insert into batch.job_dependency_waiting_launch (tenant_id, request_id, job_code, biz_date, dependency_snapshot, launch_payload) select #{tenantId}, #{requestId}, #{jobCode}, #{bizDate}, #{dependencySnapshot}::jsonb, incoming.payload from batch.trigger_request request cross join incoming where request.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and request.request_id = #{requestId} and request.job_code = #{jobCode} and request.biz_date = #{bizDate} and request.request_status in ('ACCEPTED', 'PROCESSING', 'WAITING') and jsonb_typeof(incoming.payload) = 'object' and incoming.payload ->> 'tenantId' = request.tenant_id and incoming.payload ->> 'requestId' = request.request_id and incoming.payload ->> 'jobCode' = request.job_code and incoming.payload ->> 'workflowDefinitionId' is not distinct from request.workflow_definition_id::text
and incoming.payload -> 'bizDate' = jsonb_build_array( extract(year from request.biz_date)::int, extract(month from request.biz_date)::int, extract(day from request.biz_date)::int) and coalesce(incoming.payload ->> 'dryRun', 'false') = case when request.dry_run then 'true' else 'false' end for share of request on conflict (tenant_id, request_id) do nothing
mapper.select: select from batch.job_dependency_waiting_launch where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and request_id = #{requestId} for update
select from batch.job_dependency_waiting_launch where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and wait_status = 'WAITING' order by updated_at, id limit #{limit}

select request.request_id from batch.job_dependency_waiting_launch waiting join batch.trigger_request request on request.tenant_id = waiting.tenant_id and request.request_id = waiting.request_id join batch.workflow_run run on run.tenant_id = request.tenant_id and run.id = request.parent_workflow_run_id join batch.workflow_node_run node on node.workflow_run_id = run.id and node.node_code = request.parent_node_code and node.id::text = request.launch_payload #>> '{params,_parentNodeRunId}' where waiting.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and waiting.wait_status = 'CANCELLED' and request.request_status = 'REJECTED' and run.run_status in ('CREATED', 'RUNNING') and node.node_type = 'JOB' and node.node_status = 'READY' and node.job_instance_id is null and not exists ( select 1 from batch.workflow_node_run newer where newer.workflow_run_id = node.workflow_run_id and newer.node_code = node.node_code and newer.run_seq > node.run_seq ) and not exists ( select 1 from batch.job_instance instance where instance.tenant_id = request.tenant_id and instance.trigger_request_id = request.id ) order by waiting.updated_at, waiting.id limit #{limit}

select tenant_id, request_id, job_code, biz_date, dependency_snapshot::text as dependency_snapshot, wait_status, attempt_count, last_not_ready_reason, last_checked_at, created_at, updated_at, timeout_alerted_at from batch.job_dependency_waiting_launch where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and (#{waitStatus} is null or wait_status = #{waitStatus}) and (#{jobCode} is null or job_code = #{jobCode}) order by updated_at desc, id desc limit #{limit}

select count(*) as "waitingCount", coalesce(max(extract(epoch from (current_timestamp - created_at))), 0)::bigint as "oldestAgeSeconds" from batch.job_dependency_waiting_launch where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and wait_status = 'WAITING'
mapper.update: update batch.job_dependency_waiting_launch set attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, last_not_ready_reason = #{reason}, last_checked_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and request_id = #{requestId} and wait_status = 'WAITING'

update batch.job_dependency_waiting_launch set timeout_alerted_at = #{alertedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and request_id = #{requestId} and wait_status = 'WAITING' and timeout_alerted_at is null
